name: Counter → Set Value
description: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the counter to a given value.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the counter. Must be specified if more than one counter is configured.

config_entries.label: Value
config_entries.description: The value to set. Must be within the range of a signed 64-bit integer.
